hashes_describe: Original source content before compatibility edits; origin revision defaults to v100_fork unless specified.

v100_plus/sglang_v100_plus/kernels/atten.adaptation: Only shared settings or the QSA combine function retained; ordinary paged MHA code omitted.
Only shared settings or the QSA combine function retained; ordinary paged MHA code omitted.

v100_plus/patches/marlin-v100-block-fp8-.change: Explicit block-FP8 expert prefill with exact 128x128 scale reuse; generic per-column FP8 metadata remains supported.

v100_plus/patches/marlin-v100-nvfp4.patc.change: Reduced NVFP4/FP8 SM70 build, preserving upstream bias support and build dependencies.

v100_plus/patches/marlin-v100-prefill-ga.change: 64x256x32 NVFP4 gather caches live source rows per invocation and uses aligned 128-bit FP16 input loads; arithmetic, MMA, scales and public API are unchanged.

v100_plus/patches/marlin-v100-sm70-mxfp8.change: Native FP8 E4M3 group32 scale selection/dispatch for MXFP8 W8A16; preserve packed weights, full-K FP32 MMA accumulation and FP16 reconstructed operands/output.

attention_backend.contracts: FP16 KV/state, FP32 working accumulation; FP16 snapshot carry during verification; nonintrusive bounded FP32 prefill checkpoint copied into FP16 radix state; exact paired-query selected-key multiset, capacity-bounded device support preparation, up to 4096 selected columns; optional base-2 FP32 LSE for FP16 partial-attention DCP with FP32 correction/reduction; native H8/H16/H32/H64 sparse attention; resource-bounded H32/H64 prefill staging, native H64 head tiling and direct-Q decode for DCP4/DCP8; native DFlash2 Q[8,4,128]/one-KV-head local noncausal GQA with the caller-resolved per-query left bound, device-counted FP16 prefix/current-KV gathering and FP32 split-K partials/normalizers; sparse split scheduling through eight query rows with the existing FP16 normalized-partial/FP32 LSE reduction; one-through-four-row schedules unchanged. Wider rows change rounding relative to unsplit prefill; not bit-exact model parity

dense_fp8_decode.dispatch: SM70 only, one through eight rows: PK<=256 uses one full-K Triton tile; group32 K>=1024 uses vector CUDA for four rows with logical N>=2048 and five to eight rows with N>=512. Other shapes retain the explicit SM70 Triton contraction. Existing one-through-four-row policy is unchanged.
dense_fp8_decode.contract: Original packed Marlin weights and group32/group128 FP16 scales; FP16 reconstructed operands/output and FP32 working sums/partials. Five-to-eight-row group32 CUDA projections use explicit FP32 FMA: finite FP16 products are exact in FP32. One-through-four-row arithmetic is unchanged. Caller-owned bounded scratch, padded widths and two-byte-offset scales remain supported; no new quantization or expanded weight bank.
dense_fp8_decode.validation: Independent FP64 references at unchanged rtol=.001,atol=.0002; graph replay with changed inputs/scales, bias boundaries, padded/offset scales and full-K cancellation. Five/seven/eight-row FMA partials and outputs are bit-exact to the pre-FMA CUDA implementation across changing-input/scale graph replays. Fourteen registered packed-projection GPU cases pass; the unaligned padded vector case passes memcheck with zero errors. Current three-category MiniMax messages and acceptance match the transport-only control.

glm_quad_selector_prefill.profile: GLM pool4/head128, TP8/DCP4, max1 serialized eager prefill; target and own MTP
glm_quad_selector_prefill.contract: Publish complete replicated index keys before partitioning independent query rows. Existing consecutive four-rank DCP groups score disjoint slices of a whole input chunk and exchange final selected IDs once. Share at512rows, or at64rows when rows*pooled_keys>=2^21; cheaper appends keep local scoring. Preserve FP16 operands, full-K FP32 scores/head reduction, causal lengths, physical page IDs and unsorted selected-key multisets; no KV/state quantization, new communicator, history exchange or decode/verification dispatch change.
glm_quad_selector_prefill.validation: All11target index layers plus MTP:72within-quad comparisons prove byte-identical Q/weights/keys/scales/causal lengths/page maps and identical selected sets. Eight-rank real-bank boundary/padding and concurrent TP-reduction checks pass. Actual matched8K-file appends at200K/400K gain37.4%/52.7% prefill; verification-cycle execution is flat. History-aware cutoff screens include64x32768/128x16384/256x8192 pooled-key workloads; two matched195-token appends at400K average531->561prefill and75.5->75.6generation tokens/s. Larger query batches rejected after warm-model gain of about1%; paired scheduling retained against isolated serial control. Short three-category control, images and repeated-request reuse pass.

glm_paired_prefill.profile: GLM mHC4/4096, TP8/DCP4/EP1, single-session eager prefill, ordinary or EAGLE
glm_paired_prefill.contract: Same-layer KDA state and DSA key publication precede the next chunk; owned metadata/mHC/forward flags, one compute stream and a per-pair communication stream; FP16 KV/state boundaries and global TP sums preserved. Active paired forwards use replicated mHC PRE with the existing exact fused full-row cast/mean, avoiding two local gathers per PRE; other prefill layouts keep their partition choice.
glm_paired_prefill.validation: Bit-exact whole-model outputs and KDA/conv state on all eight ranks with fixed selected-key order; exact full/sharded mHC results on both captured stage banks, full-range changed-input graph/canary and memcheck checks; live-indexer three-category throughput, image input,15.8K continuation, prefix reuse and CPU ownership/compile regressions.

glm_dflash_window.profile: FP4-Local TP8/DCP4 target, replicated TP8/DCP1 DFlash2 FP16 draft, block8, max1, prefix capacity2048; model window2048 resolves to inclusive left bound2047
glm_dflash_window.contract: Triton backend retains draft metadata and cache writes; native Volta FA computes attention, preserving each query left bound and noncausal right support. Thirty-three key splits times four heads expose132 CTAs; bounded caller/stream-owned scratch and FP32 reduction, no expanded persistent KV or CPU count reads. Unsupported geometry/masks fail explicitly. Target packed-FP8 projection coverage extends through eight rows without changing checkpoint weights.
glm_dflash_window.validation: Native/FP64 and original Triton comparisons at unchanged rtol=.001,atol=.0002 on baseline-calibrated inputs; actual backend/config window semantics, changed-count/input CUDA graphs, boundary IDs/strides, poisoned scratch, canaries, memcheck and synccheck. Uninstrumented three-category near8K/256-output/T0 model: mean2358->2359 prefill and26.2->64.3 generation tokens/s,141.36->55.57ms complete cycles. Images and repeated-prefix reuse pass. Two of three greedy texts change with reduction order; not bit-exact model parity. Full-window DFlash qualification and lab-sampled performance remain separate.

minimax_quad_collectives.profile: MiniMax M3.1 TP8/PP1/EP1, max1, native DSpark8, 10K context/10496 pool, chunk1024, FP16 main/index/draft KV and vision; two complete NVLink quads, one Gen1x8 endpoint.
minimax_quad_collectives.contract: Validate consecutive four-rank NVLink cliques, select three fast PCIe endpoints per quad from live topology, then perform quad sums, disjoint cross-quad pair sums and quad distribution. FP16 messages >=64KiB use this path; tiny sums and gathers reuse the existing global PyNccl communicator. Four-CTA subgroup bounds, invocation-owned outputs and graph-safe static stripe capacity; no CPU device-count reads or persistent expanded weights. FP16 summation order changes versus the global tree.
minimax_quad_collectives.validation: Eight-rank FP64 controls, input/output canaries and changing-input CUDA-graph replay including odd tails. Same three coherent near8K/256-output T0/531 categories: 823.53->1525.36 prefill and45.35->59.56 generation TPS. Transport-only:1524.30/57.11; subsequent FMA, packed auxiliary collector and native-communicator reuse:4.3% faster generation with identical messages/acceptance. Images with long text, tools, T1/P.95,8064-token reuse and10208input+30output boundary pass; no retractions. Larger paired prefill exceeded VRAM and was removed.

glm_fp4_local.implementation: Indexed nested-shard completion and block-scale normalization; lossless CPU CSF32 expansion before TP slicing; native SM70 MXFP8 group32 W8A16; fixed FP16 MLA / FP32 indexer projection boundaries; original quantized weights and global calibration preserved.
glm_fp4_local.status: Validated TP8/DCP4 ordinary/MTP3, images and prefix reuse with FP16 KV/state. Own NVFP4 MTP required. Full1M runtime completed on2026-10-22; current hosting/development target524288. Comprehensive long-context numerical/quality evaluation is separate. Own-head MTP4/5 are officially supported and execute; the current near8K/T0 screen keeps the compatible MTP3 reference fastest at89.1generation TPS. Wider sparse split scheduling improves MTP4 72.2->77.7 and MTP5 73.9->80.9generation TPS with flat prefill; image/prefix reuse and lab-sampled execution pass for both, without a new full-window fill.
